question: What changed the Thunder’s chance of winning their first title?
orientation: November 2024–May 2025. Rank five headlines from the biggest rise in Oklahoma City’s chance of winning the NBA championship to the biggest fall.
measurementNotes: Final five: Holmgren injury, NBA Cup loss, Holmgren return, Denver Game 7 and Finals berth. Replaces routine opener/season record/first-round sweep for narrative significance; new cards frozen before new measurements, with earlier scores already visible.

All selected article sources have explicit UTC publication metadata. Use the latest declared article update as a conservative cutoff. Holmgren return’s February 8 update is used for the completed return, not the February 6 advance announcement.
The NBA Cup is a separate midseason tournament. Losing it did not eliminate Oklahoma City from the NBA championship contract.
Denver Game 7 removes a recent champion; the subsequent Minnesota series can affect broad follow-up windows. Event effects are not independent or causal.
Use inclusive one-point anchor ties with 1e-12 tolerance. Do not fabricate an ordering within tied groups.
Snapshots establish the retrieved bytes, not historical page immutability. Original raw observations, rejected rows and gaps are preserved. No full market-lifetime claim.
